messages.subject: Assistance Needed for Crop Calibration
messages.body_plain:
Hi Tam,

I hope you're doing well.

I'm currently working on adjusting R-SWAT for crop calibration and need some guidance. Specifically, I want to select the crop calibration and set observation data based on yearly conditions for parameter sampling. Note - I calibrated the flow.

Could you please help me with the steps and file needed to execute to accomplish this in R-SWAT? I think one file is crop/plant.dat.

For example, I have yearly yield data for Turnips measured in tons per hectare (t/ha).

Year Yield
2002 20,800
2003 22,400
2004 19,600
2005 21,500
2006 17,500
2007 21,200
2008 21,000
2009 26,800
2010 16,900
2011 20,900
2012 23,800
2013 28,200
2014 18,900
2015 25,200
2016 27,000
2017 20,000
2018 16,461

Note: I have already calibrated the flow.

Could you please help me with the steps to accomplish this in R-SWAT?

Thank you!

Best regards,
Kamal

messages.subject: Re: Monthly calibration for SWAT using R-SWAT
messages.subject_clean: Monthly calibration for SWAT using R-SWAT
messages.body_plain:
Dear Tam,

in the script of userReadSwatOutput.R <https://github.com/tamnva/R-SWAT/wiki/data/userReadSwatOutput_Example1.7z> the FUN= "sum". So, it aggregates the daily values by summing them within a month. Shouldn't that be mean? Observed data is average values to be in the same line as the FLOW_OUT variable in output.rch to perform the calibration.
Thanks for your time,

Best,

Amparo

messages.subject: CALIBRATION
messages.body_plain:
Good day everyone,

I am in the process of calibrating my SWAT+ model using R-SWAT, specifically in step 2: Parameter Sampling (1. Selection of SWAT parameters for calibration and/or sensitivity analysis). My question is: Should each parameter be associated with a specific type of change (relative, absolute, replacement), or can all parameters be associated with any of these three types of change?

Could someone provide me with information on this? Additionally, I would like to know what an average number of iterations necessary for calibration is and how many parameters should be calibrated. Although I have reviewed the literature and have not found an exact number, I would like to hear about your experiences.

I appreciate your collaboration in advance.
